$comment: High/critical production advisories the CI audit gate tolerates. Each entry needs a reachability reason and a reviewBy date; an expired entry fails the gate so it gets re-checked. Remove an entry as soon as a patched release exists.

exceptions.reason: No patched release (vulnerable <=1.4.0, latest 1.4.0). The flaw is in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification; 9Router only uses node-forge in src/mitm/cert/rootCA.js to generate keys and sign/serialize its own MITM certificates and never verifies an external signature with it.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade node-forge once a fixed release ships. Replacing it means another certificate issuer (e.g. @peculiar/x509 over WebCrypto): node:crypto can generate keys and parse X509Certificate but cannot create or sign certificates.
